question: By how much did the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fall short of the baseline's?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%capacity%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%mah%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 14 AND 24 ORDER BY line_no
SELECT printf('%.1f', CAST(regexp_extract(text,'were ([0-9.]+) and',1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(text,'and ([0-9.]+) mAh',1) AS DOUBLE)) AS shortfall FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L21'

door_refusals.why: the text "'%.1f'" puts digits into the value "PRINTF('%.1f', CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(text, 'were ([0-9.]+) and', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(text, 'and ([0-9.]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE)) AS shortfall" — a value may only carry numbers read from atoms
moves: read the number from the atom that holds it (e.g. regexp_extract over its text) instead of typing it
for a unit factor or physical constant, read it from consts: (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id = 'K.per_kilo')
0, 1 and 100 are allowed as written; constants in WHERE/ON (choosing) are always allowed
